tagline: Back roads toward a lighthouse standing in the bay.
intro: Route 14, the New Point Comfort Highway, comes down through the county seat at Mathews toward the tip of the peninsula. The byway makes a loop off it, from Bavon through Port Haywood to Mathews and back around, with side roads out to Haven Beach and Bethel Beach.
Another run follows North River Road and East River Road from North toward Mobjack.

moments.title: Mathews
moments.text: The county seat began about 1700 as Westville, on Put-in Creek, a name sometimes misspelled Pudding Creek, a tidal stream feeding the East River.

moments.title: Bethel Beach
moments.text: A state preserve of beach, low dune and salt marsh by the bay, sheltering two globally rare species, the northeastern beach tiger beetle and sea-beach knotweed.

moments.title: New Point Comfort Light
moments.text: Its builder settled a quarrel over the site by buying the whole island, and the 1804 tower now stands surrounded by water, seen from a walkway at the county's southern tip.
